links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT Chinese myopia responses measured with the Chinese Readability Index Explorer (CRIE)
links.effect: CRIE scores for 20 ChatGPT responses ranged from 7.29 to 12.09, equivalent to a middle-to-high school reading level. Only 35% of responses met all appropriateness, usability, and clarity criteria.
links.quote: The CRIE scores for 20 ChatGPT responses ranged from 7.29 to 12.09, indicating that the readability level was equivalent to a middle-to-high school level.

screen.reason: Evaluates the quality, usability, and readability of ChatGPT responses to patient/caregiver myopia FAQs without testing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
